overview: Full K3s cluster bootstrap for Server A: installs K3s, Traefik ingress, Kubernetes Dashboard, and optionally Argo CD. Configures HTTPS ingress at acd.*, dash.*, and traefik.* on your domain. Auto-detects public IP, verifies DNS before Let's Encrypt, and skips SSL until DNS is ready.
prerequisites: Domain name (e.g. srv1.example.com) with DNS you control
Ports 80 and 443 open to the internet for HTTPS
Port 6443 restricted to your admin IP (use himosoft-firewall)

steps.title: Add the mirror
steps.body: Run once per server if the mirror is not already configured.

steps.title: Install the package
steps.body: Installs the CLI and bootstrap scripts.
steps.command: sudo apt update && sudo apt install himosoft-k3s-server

steps.title: Run interactive setup
steps.body: Prompts for public IP (auto-detected default), base domain, hostnames, optional Argo CD, and ACME email. Installs K3s, Traefik, dashboards, and ingress.

steps.title: Point DNS
steps.body: Create A records for acd.*, dash.*, and traefik.* pointing to your server's public IP.
steps.command:
# Example:
# acd.srv1.example.com     -> YOUR_PUBLIC_IP
# dash.srv1.example.com    -> YOUR_PUBLIC_IP
# traefik.srv1.example.com -> YOUR_PUBLIC_IP

steps.title: Enable Let's Encrypt (after DNS)
steps.body: Re-checks DNS and switches Traefik to real certificates when all hostnames resolve correctly.

steps.title: Get login credentials
steps.body: Shows Argo CD admin password and Kubernetes Dashboard token.

commands.description: Platform only — K3s must already be running
Fix Argo CD redirect loop behind Traefik
Verify DNS and enable Let's Encrypt
Fix Argo CD in wrong namespace and re-bootstrap
Cluster health, URLs, and pod summary
Argo CD password and dashboard token

notes: Argo CD install is optional — answer Y/n at the prompt
If Argo CD shows a blank page or redirect loop, run fix-ingress
Traefik is pre-installed — skip duplicate Traefik in GitOps Phase 2 or adopt the existing release
Verify cluster: k3s kubectl get pods -A
